events.name: Grey Rain
events.blurb: The sky rinses color out of the streets. Even revived hands slow.
events.say: Grey rain. Even the mended ones are slowing.
events.news: Grey rain over {town}. {name} says even the mended ones are slowing.

events.name: Stranger with Embers
events.blurb: A traveler cups a dying coal and asks if you still know how.
events.say: A stranger came through cupping a coal. Asked after someone who still knows how.
events.news: A stranger with embers passed through {town}. {name} says they were asking after someone who still knows how.
events.newsHere: A stranger cups a dying coal by the {town} hearth and asks if you still know how. You do. {name} watches it catch.

events.name: Bad News Rider
events.blurb: Hoofbeats. A letter. Someone's almost-healed crack splits.
events.say: A rider came at first light. {target} read the letter twice.
events.news: A rider brought bad news to {town}. {name} says {target} took it hard.

events.name: Market Ghost
events.blurb: Stalls stand like ribs. Trade feels like a rumor.
events.say: Stalls standing like ribs. Nobody's buying.
events.news: The market in {town} stood empty this morning. {name} says trade feels like a rumor.

events.name: A Child Laughs
events.blurb: Short. Bright. Unreasonable. It helps more than it should.
events.say: Did you hear that? A child, laughing.
events.news: A child laughed in {town}, short and bright. {name} says it helped {target} more than it should.
events.newsHere: Somewhere in {town} a child laughs. Short. Bright. {name} looks up, and so does {target}.

events.name: Rumor of the Hill
events.blurb: Children say the hill walks. A shutter unlatches from the wrong side — a breach for something large.
events.say: The little ones say the hill walks. I don't laugh at it.
events.news: Children in {town} say the hill walks. {name} found a shutter unlatched from the wrong side.

events.name: Den Goes Cold
events.blurb: You pushed through the night without banking the den fire. Morning takes its cut.
events.say: Nobody banked the den fire. It's cold in here.
events.news: The den fire went out while you were away. {name} says the hollow in {town} is cold this morning.
